text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brian is in the lead! Brian takes first place!
With a truly majestic run, she crosseees the finish liiine!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is strong, far too strong!
She puts herself in position to claim the Spring Shield!

text_block_list.name: Man with Undercut
text_block_list.text:
That's way too out of this world...
I've never seen a late-stage burst like that...!

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's her,
she will make our dream come true."

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text: Take first place in every single GI race! And blow past Rudolf's GI record too!

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text: "With speed like that, she could even take the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! We could reach a glory never before seen in Tracen Academy's history!"

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text: —If it's our ultimate strength, we can!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haaa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(You really are always ahead of me, aren't you?
...My "inspiration.")

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Still...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you're moving forward,
then I will go—forward too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because if I overtake them,
I know I can grow even more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—...Whoa.
It's so sparkly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, amazing—she's so fast!
So this is Narita Brian-san's running!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ My heart won't stop pounding.
It's racing so fast, it's so thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Maya too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If I run with Brian-san,
do you think I can become sparkly too?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eheh—♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days had passed since Narita Brian's shocking performance in the Hanshin Daishoten stunned the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A piece of breaking news took the world by storm.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Narita Brian has announced
that she will withdraw from the Tenno Sho (Spring)
due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: "After the Hanshin Daishoten, she felt discomfort in her lower back, and detailed examinations revealed an abnormality in her hip joint."

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
She announced that she will prioritize recovering from her injury
for the time being and refrain from entering races.

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store A
text_block_list.text: No way, Brian got injured...

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store B
text_block_list.text: ...I heard she's going in and out of the hospital for a while, so she won't be racing.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, so that means we won't get to see Lady Brian run anymore~?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
And taking such a long break must mean
it's a really severe injury...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Brian will make a comeback!
Without a doubt! Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Her mental game is total monster tier too!
Even at the Kikuka Sho, she was so strong that none of the anxiety or tension around her mattered at all!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish my rehab and be right back!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —Because they're our "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's been announced that Brian-chan
will be bypassing the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It is a bit regrettable.
The day when we could compete for the pinnacle
with all our might has been pushed further away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what we need to do
remains the same!
choice_data_list: This is our chance to close the gap they put on display!
This is our chance to close the gap they showed us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That's right♪
We need to make up for the ground Brian-chan gained on us in the Hanshin Daishoten!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: We're not the ones who wait, after all.
